# DAIV

> DAIV is an open-source, self-hosted AI coding agent for GitLab and GitHub that turns issues into merge requests, answers review comments and fixes failing CI.

This site holds the documentation of every DAIV release. The current release's documentation is under /latest/.

## Docs

- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.daivagent.com/latest/llms.txt): every page of the current release's documentation, each with a Markdown version
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://docs.daivagent.com/latest/llms-full.txt): the current release's documentation in one Markdown file

## Optional

- [DAIV website for LLMs](https://daivagent.com/llms.txt): what DAIV is, its FAQ, comparisons with other tools and blog posts
